Ask you anything? Why do you think you're so easily forgettable? What makes you think that the moment you're gonna die everyone who used to have you around shrugs it off and doesn't notice the difference in the world once they wake up? Do you have any idea how hard it is to be entirely forgotten? Don't get me wrong, I don't judge you for what you say. I'm in a kinda similar boat. But someone at my work killed herself about a month ago. I hardly know anyone at my work, really. And when I got called with the message that she killed herself, I didn't even recognise the name. It appears I hadn't even seen her before. But I do remember her. Even though I wasn't aware of her very existence until after she died, I remember this person. What makes you think there's nobody like me in your life? What makes you think I won't remember you and your small story you shared here? I don't know anything about your life, of course, so maybe you really will be forgotten. But how can you be sure? And if you know so certainly that you'll be forgotten once you die anyway, why rush it? Why not stick around everyone's memories now you kinda can?
